item.name: Advanced - Filter Posts and Validate User

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
const posts = pm.response.json();
pm.test("Response is a non-empty array with at most five posts", function () { pm.expect(posts).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(posts.length).to.be.within(1, 5); });
pm.test("Every result matches the requested userId", function () { posts.forEach(function (post) { pm.expect(post.userId).to.eql(1); }); });
pm.test("Post IDs are unique", function () { const ids = posts.map(function (post) { return post.id; }); pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(ids.length); });

pm.test("Every result has valid required fields", function () { posts.forEach(function (post) { pm.expect(post.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(post.title).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.expect(post.body).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; }); });
pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
const posts = pm.response.json();
pm.test("Pagination returns exactly five posts", function () { pm.expect(posts).to.be.an("array").with.lengthOf(5); });
pm.test("Pagination returns the expected ID window", function () { const ids = posts.map(function (post) { return post.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.eql([11, 12, 13, 14, 15]); });

pm.test("Pagination results are in ascending ID order", function () { const ids = posts.map(function (post) { return post.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.eql(ids.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; })); });

item.name: Advanced - Filter With No Matching User

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Response is JSON", function () { pm.response.to.be.json; });
pm.test("No matching records returns an empty array", function () { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(data).to.be.an("array").that.is.empty; });
